title: Marcos thanks Filipinos, agencies for successful ASEAN 2026 hosting
summary: President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. has expressed his gratitude to government agencies, personnel, volunteers, and the Filipino people for their contribution to the country's successful hosting…

blocks.text: President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. has expressed his gratitude to government agencies, personnel, volunteers, and the Filipino people for their contribution to the country's successful hosting of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian (ASEAN) Summit and Related Summits.
"This was the product of the hard work and dedication of a multitude of people and agencies, each of whom played an important role in making this Summit a success," Marcos said in a statement.
He also thanked the Filipino people for their "patience, understanding, and cooperation."
"I also wish to express my special thanks to the Filipino people, particularly those whose daily routines were affected by the preparations and activities surrounding the Summit," the President said.
"[F]or that warmth and generosity you have shown our guests. You have once again demonstrated the hospitality for which Filipinos are known around the world," he added.
On Tuesday, the Philippines formally handed over the chairship of ASEAN to Singapore during the culmination of the 49th international conference.
In his speech, Marcos told Singaporean Prime Minister Lawrence Wong that the Philippines has the “utmost confidence” in Singapore’s leadership of the regional bloc.

Among the achievements highlighted during the Summit is the signing of the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA), which establishes a region-wide framework for cross-border digital trade and e-commerce, the first agreement of its kind in the world. —AOL, GMA News
